wnba.Headline: Valkyries beat the Fever 88-75 for 8th straight victory
wnba.Description: — Gabby Williams scored 16 points, Kaitlyn Chen had 14 points, all in the second half, and the Golden State Valkyries beat the Indiana Fever 88-75 on Wednesday night for the second-year franchise's record eighth straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Indiana Fever vs. Golden State Valkyries - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Indiana Fever vs. Golden State Valkyries, 07/15/2026

wnba.Headline: Full list of every ESPYS 2026 Award winner
wnba.Description: The 2026 ESPYS are underway. From Jalen Brunson to A'ja Wilson, find out which athletes won.

wnba.Headline: Cynthia Cooper, Teresa Weatherspoon excited about their ASG rosters
wnba.Description: Cynthia Cooper, Teresa Weatherspoon excited about their ASG rosters

wnba.Headline: Teresa Weatherspoon, Cynthia Cooper pick WNBA All-Star teams
wnba.Description: Teresa Weatherspoon bragged about the competitiveness of her team as the 2026 WNBA All-Star draft concluded Wednesday. Her All-Star general manager counterpart Cynthia Cooper said in response: "But can you score enough points?"

wnba.Headline: Lynx beat the Sparks 96-87 behind Kayla McBride's 5th straight 20-point game
wnba.Description: — Kayla McBride scored 24 for her fifth straight 20-point performance, Courtney Williams added 19 points, and the Minnesota Lynx beat the Los Angeles Sparks 96-87 on Wednesday for their fourth straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota Lynx vs. Los Angeles Sparks - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Minnesota Lynx vs. Los Angeles Sparks, 07/15/2026

wnba.Headline: Azura Stevens scores 18 of her 20 points in the 1st half and the Sky beat the Storm 95-90
wnba.Description: — Azura Stevens scored 18 of her 20 points in the first half, Sydney Taylor added 17 points, and the Chicago Sky beat the Seattle Storm 95-90 on Wednesday.

wnba.Headline: Chicago Sky vs. Seattle Storm - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Chicago Sky vs. Seattle Storm, 07/15/2026

wnba.Headline: How the expansion Portland Fire are bringing CLA training to the WNBA
wnba.Description: The Constraints-Led Approach has been around for decades, but coach Alex Sarama has brought it to the WNBA for the first time.

wnba.Headline: Bueckers leads Dallas against New York after 22-point showing
wnba.Description: New York Liberty (13-11, 8-2 Eastern Conference) at Dallas Wings (16-8, 6-6 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Portland visits Washington after Iriafen's 25-point outing
wnba.Description: Portland Fire (10-14, 3-6 Western Conference) at Washington Mystics (12-10, 8-5 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Mystics power past short-handed Tempo 79-62 behind double-doubles by Iriafen and Austin
wnba.Description: — Kiki Iriafen had 25 points and 14 rebounds, Shakira Austin added 17 points and 10 rebounds, and the Washington Mystics beat the Toronto Tempo 79-62 on Tuesday night.

wnba.Headline: Toronto Tempo vs. Washington Mystics - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Toronto Tempo vs. Washington Mystics, 07/14/2026

wnba.Headline: Man fired after alleged racist message to Aces' Chelsea Gray
wnba.Description: Hilton Grand Vacations said Tuesday that it has fired a man who allegedly sent a racist message to Aces guard Chelsea Gray on social media.

wnba.Headline: Aaliyah Edwards and Brittney Griner each score 20-plus to lead the Sun past the Fire 90-87
wnba.Description: — Aaliyah Edwards scored 21 points off the bench, Brittney Griner added 20, and the Connecticut Sun beat the Portland Fire 90-87 on Tuesday.

wnba.Headline: Connecticut Sun vs. Fire - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Connecticut Sun vs. Fire, 07/14/2026

wnba.Headline: Updated fantasy women's basketball rankings: Marina Mabrey moves into top 10
wnba.Description: As we approach the WNBA All-Star break, here are the updated Fantasy Women's Basketball rankings.

wnba.Headline: Paige Bueckers bemoans WNBA's lack of Black women head coaches
wnba.Description: Wings star Paige Bueckers called out the lack of Black women head coaches in the WNBA, saying Black women deserve "the same equal opportunity" to coach in the league.

wnba.Headline: WNBA Power Rankings: The Indiana Fever are running hot
wnba.Description: With Kelsey Mitchell posting her sixth straight game with 25 points or more, Indiana moves up to No. 4. Golden State holds on to the top spot.
